current_unit: Task 5: Tray + director window characterization tests (modify tests/electron-chrome-windows.test.ts)
notes: Task 4 complete: extended tests/window-managers.test.ts with prompter + media-library window manager characterization tests. Fixed against real signatures: (1) prompter manager's config is {getPort, getDisplayPreference?}, no store param; (2) open() places the window via bounds passed into the BrowserWindow constructor, not a post-construction setBounds() call, so the display-targeting assertion reads electronMock.windows[0].options.x instead of a setBounds call; (3) media-library manager has no open() method at all -- window creation lives inside the store.subscribe() callback wired by initialize(), gated on currentMode==='media-library' plus a resolvable mediaLibrary.activeItemId via media.findById(); built a minimal duck-typed MediaLibraryStore fake (findById + absolutePath only, cast as unknown as MediaLibraryStore) instead of the real fs-backed createMediaLibraryStore(), and drove reuse via two store.setState() calls with the same activeItemId. No electron-mock.ts changes needed. Verified npx tsc --noEmit clean and npx vitest run clean (1194/1194) except tests/companion-defs.test.ts, the same pre-existing unrelated packages/companion-module-pconair deps gap documented since Task 1. Container had no node_modules at session start -- ran npm ci first. IMPORTANT for Task 5: tests/electron-chrome-windows.test.ts currently has ONE test using Task 2's per-test resetModules()+re-import pattern; Task 5 adds two more describe blocks each with their own resetModules() in beforeEach, which is the same multi-resetModules-in-one-file shape Task 3 found breaks down past the first test in tests/window-managers.test.ts. Decide up front whether to keep and re-verify Task 2's pattern with three describe blocks, or switch this file to the top-level-import/no-resetModules pattern already proven there, rather than rediscovering the failure mode mid-task. Per the roadmap, Task 5 is dispatched alone next firing, not concurrently with Tasks 6-9.
